findings.title: Mis-sharded-connection discard path doesn't decrement total_connections gauge
findings.claim: In handle_ready_connection, the mis-sharded-connection arm is the only discard path that still drops a connection without decrementing the total_connections gauge.

findings.title: Keyspace check moved ahead of maybe_reshard could race the sharder
findings.claim: Checked whether moving the keyspace check ahead of maybe_reshard risks the sharder not being learned before a parallel fill; confirmed it costs nothing since start_filling opens only one connection while the pool is empty and is_filling() blocks a refill during the USE round-trip.

findings.title: Potential double-counting in decrement_total_connections via shared_conns
findings.claim: Checked each new decrement_total_connections site for double-counting caused by shared_conns keeping cleared Arcs alive; found no such issue because remove_connection's Arc::ptr_eq lookup fails in every such window, which matters since the counter is an AtomicU64 and an over-decrement would wrap.
